claim_text: Multi-vehicle collision on the M6 motorway southbound on 22 March 2024 at 07:45 AM involving four vehicles during morning rush hour. The claimant, Mr. James Holloway (42), was hospitalised immediately following the incident with a confirmed spinal injury and is currently receiving treatment at Manchester Royal Infirmary. His wife and two children, who were passengers, also sustained minor injuries and are under medical observation. Mr. Holloway is unable to work and the family is facing mounting medical bills and loss of income. The family's solicitor has contacted us requesting an emergency settlement advance to cover immediate medical expenses and household costs. Liability is disputed between two of the other drivers involved. Time-sensitive: medical team advises that rehabilitation decisions must be made within 10 days to avoid long-term complications.
